critique: The piece is sequentially correct but thin: each beat is one property on one layer. The 36px low-contrast tagline is undersized against the 150px wordmark and leaves the lockup bottom-light.

Tighten the ring draw to ~0.6s with an Expo/Quart Out. Give the mark a small reaction as the wordmark exits from behind it, such as a slight scale or rotation pulse or the slash nudging. Replace the keyed bounce with a single spring or overshoot ease. Enlarge the tagline to ~48–56px with a touch more contrast, and align its left edge exactly to the N (currently 12px off).
